Alignment pass over `docs/helix` is complete and read-only: no artifact was edited. The five artifacts (vision, PRD, FEAT-recipe-share, ADR-001, TD-recipe-store) have 16 material gaps: 8 divergent, 4 incomplete, 3 underspecified, 1 blocked.

Catalog bound from the source checkout (`/home/erik/Projects/helix/workflows`). The `depends_on` chain resolves cleanly (vision → PRD → FEAT/ADR → TD), so the drift is in content, not in the graph.

## Contradictions and drift

| ID | Severity | What disagrees |
|---|---|---|
| F-1 | high | The TD schema is PostgreSQL dialect (`gen_random_uuid()`, `UUID`, `VARCHAR`), which contradicts ADR-001's SQLite decision; `gen_random_uuid()` does not exist in SQLite. |
| F-2 | high | SHARE-04 requires a draft → published transition, but the same FEAT puts "Draft recipes" out of scope and the TD only has `published`. |
| F-3 | high | The TD adds a `DELETE /recipes/{id}` endpoint, delete authorization, and a rollback that deletes recipe records. The FEAT forbids recipe deletion and photo changes and requires "published recipes never lost". |
| F-4 | high | Recipe-volume targets do not reconcile: the vision says 500 community recipes by month 6, the PRD says 500 seeded at launch plus 100 community in 3 months, and the FEAT says both 500 by month 6 and 25/month by month 3. The PRD also lists seed count as an open question. |
| F-5 | medium | Capacity numbers conflict: ADR-001 sizes for ≤100 concurrent users with ~10–20 writes/sec and a migration trigger at ≥5 concurrent writes. The FEAT requires 100 concurrent publishers, and the TD expects 1000 concurrent reads, past the ADR's 200-user review trigger. |
| F-6 | medium | SHARE-02 disables submit until title and instructions are present, but its acceptance criterion clicks submit on a title-only form. The rule also omits ingredients, while SHARE-01's criterion includes them. |
| F-7 | medium | The vision narrative has "adds ingredients to her cart" and "likes"; the PRD makes grocery integration a non-goal and has no likes requirement. |
| F-16 | medium | Review checklists are fully ticked in all four documents, but at least 8 ticks are false (e.g. "No contradictions", "Dependencies reference real artifacts", "Integration points specify S3 fallback" where the fallback is "None"). |

## Missing downstream coverage

| ID | Severity | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| F-8 | high | Five of six PRD P0 requirements (browse, save, rate, comment, view saved) have no feature spec. FEAT-ratings and FEAT-comments are cited as dependencies but do not exist; P1/P2 have nothing either. |
| F-9 | high | Moderation is a PRD legal constraint, a risk mitigation and a launch success criterion. Its only downstream trace is one FEAT edge-case line with no requirement ID, deferred to v2, and nothing in the TD. |
| F-10 | medium | The TD covers only part of SHARE-01..08: no profile listing by author, no detail or card statistics, no `PUT` schema, no flagging. It names `ratings` and `comments` tables without defining them and references an undefined `users` table. |
| F-11 | medium | Dangling references: `docs/helix/parking-lot.md`, the `user-stories/` directory, the TD's "User Story: Sharing recipes", the ADR's runbook and Postgres migration guide. ADR backup/RTO and disk-monitoring commitments have no design coverage, and there is no test plan or implementation plan. |

## Blocked and underspecified

| ID | Severity | Issue |
|---|---|---|
| F-12 | medium | The PRD says the image-storage and moderation open questions block upload and safety, yet the FEAT and TD commit to S3. ADR-001 is still Proposed/draft while the PRD and TD treat SQLite as settled. |
| F-13 | medium | The TD and FEAT assert existing implementation (auth endpoints, read-only browsing, SQLite initialisation), but the repo has no code and no artifact governing auth or browse. |
| F-14 | low | Imprecise requirements: 800x600 resize of a 2000x2000 image with no aspect-ratio rule, PNG renamed `.jpg`, "400+ errors", "trending" defined as creation-date sort, and acceptance criteria for SHARE-06/07 that omit required fields. |
| F-15 | low | Requirements introduced below their authority: SHARE-08 (edit) has no PRD parent, and the TD adds title/description length limits absent from the FEAT. |

## Recommended next step

Run `evolve` to settle the upstream decisions first: recipe-volume targets, draft lifecycle, deletion policy, and capacity envelope (F-2 to F-5). Then `frame` the missing feature specs (F-8, F-9), and `design` to rework the TD against SQLite (F-1, F-10).
